sources.citation: EG4 3000 EHV-48 — 'Modbus_RTU RS232 communication protocol', Version: June 2022 Version 1.0 (vendor document). Committed at docs/eg4-3000ehv-modbus-protocol-v1.0.pdf

https://github.com/HotNoob/PythonProtocolGateway/blob/main/protocols/eg4/eg4_3000ehv_v1.holding_registry_map.csv (transcription verified line-by-line against the vendor PDF for regs 201–234, 313, 332, 420, 426)

transport: RS-232 · Modbus RTU · FC 0x03 read / 0x10 write · device address 1–247 (example frames use 01H) · baud NOT stated in the vendor document
blocks: hold 100–101 32-bit fault bitmap · 108–109 32-bit warning bitmap · 186–197 serial number ASCII · 201–234 real-time measurements · 300–337 configuration · 406/420/426 remote control · 643 rated power. All registers are holding registers read with 0x03; there is no input-register space.
gotchas: This is a COMPLETELY different map from the XP/kPV/FlexBOSS line. Nothing overlaps: the 3000EHV uses holding registers in the 100–643 range read with 0x03, the Luxpower-based line uses input registers 0–174 read with 0x04. Do not reuse a driver.

The vendor document is titled 'Modbus_RTU RS232 communication protocol' — the host protocol port is RS-232, not RS-485, contradicting the Quebec retailer's 'RS-485, RS-232' claim. The RS-485 port on this unit is the battery BMS bus: jstormes/eg3000-s9 sniffs RS-485 between a 3000EHV-48 and LiFePower4 packs, not between

The vendor document does NOT state a baud rate, parity or stop bits anywhere. HotNoob/PythonProtocolGateway's eg4_3000ehv_v1.json declares baud 9600 — that is community-single and must be bench-confirmed. Left null here deliberately.

Block-alignment rule: a read must not start or end inside the serial-number block (186–197). The doc says the start address and (start + count) must both fall outside 186–198 or the returned data is wrong.

A parse failure does NOT return a Modbus exception. The doc's error case returns a normal-looking 0x03 response of N zero bytes with a valid CRC. A driver that only checks for exception codes will silently ingest zeros as real readings.
unmappedReports: working-mode enum (201: 0 power-on, 1 standby, 2 mains, 3 off-grid, 4 bypass, 5 charging, 6 fault) — not a charge-stage and not a run-state, three separate AC rails each with their own voltage/current/frequency/power: mains 202–204, inverter 205–209, output 210–214 — only one ac-* family of MetricKinds, inverter charging power (209) and inverter charging average current (233) — the AC-charger leg, PV charging average power (224) and PV charging average current (234), distinct from PV average power (223), load percentage (225, % of rated) — no load-percent MetricKind, two device temperatures: DCDC module (226) and inverter (227) — temperature is one kind, output mode (300: single / parallel / 3-phase P1–P3 / split-phase P1–P2) and output priority (301: Utility-PV-Battery, PV-Utility-Battery, PV-Battery-Utility), battery charging priority (331: utility / PV / equal / PV-only), 32-bit fault bitmap (100–101, 27 defined bits) and 32-bit warning bitmap (108–109, 19 defined bits), rated power (643) and 12-register ASCII serial number (186–197), no state-of-health, no cycle count, no energy totals or daily energy anywhere on this map
